title: Pattalam
desc: In a school, two groups of students constantly fight each other and cause chaos. However, a psychologist named Daisy believes that they can be disciplined through love and positivity.

title: Vanavil
desc: Surya, Prakash and Priya are three IAS aspirants. When Surya and Priya fall in love, Prakash, Priya's secret admirer, silently becomes an enemy posing as a friend and plots to get rid of Surya.

title: Ettupatti Rasa
desc: Singarasu's brave and helpful nature makes him the guardian of eight villages. However, his life takes an unfortunate turn when he puts his duty above all else.

title: Deepavali
desc: A rich woman gets exploited by her relatives after she loses her son. Her troubles vanish after Ravi treats her like his mother and protects her from the wicked people.
